body:
The BLUECONNECT Kick-Off Meeting brought together researchers, businesses and public organisations in Kotor, Montenegro, on 3 October 2024. Held at Hotel Vardar within the AdriBioPro2024 conference programme, the event opened a dialogue on innovation and cross-border cooperation between Croatia, Bosnia and Herzegovina, and Montenegro.

This gallery captures moments from the project presentations, interactive stakeholder session and networking programme. Working as an expert supporting the Institute of Marine Biology, University of Montenegro, I presented the project roadmap and facilitated discussions connecting BLUECONNECT’s objectives with participants’ experience, interests and practical needs.

The interactive session invited stakeholders to identify challenges, share ideas and explore potential partnerships. Conversations around the tables helped connect research expertise, business perspectives and institutional support with the project’s planned collaboration platform and pilot activities.

From structured discussions to informal exchanges, these photographs document the people and conversations that marked the beginning of BLUECONNECT’s collaborative work.
